***Partnership with*** *Established Southern California Behavioral Health Provider*


***Aims to Accelerate Innovative Application of Interventional Psychiatry Treatments***


**BURLINGTON, Mass. and JERUSALEM, October 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE)** – BrainsWay Ltd. (NASDAQ & TASE: BWAY) (“BrainsWay” or the “Company”), a global leader in advanced non-invasive neurostimulation treatments for mental health disorders, today announced a strategic collaboration with Inland Psychiatric Medical Group (“IPMG”), an established provider of comprehensive behavioral health services across Southern California.


IPMG operates a multidisciplinary behavioral health practice serving patients throughout Southern California, including in Riverside, San Bernardino, Los Angeles, and Orange Counties. Its comprehensive clinical services include psychiatry, medication management, psychotherapy, TMS therapy, esketamine treatment, and clinical research.


The collaboration with BrainsWay includes a multisystem order of BrainsWay Deep TMS systems planned for installation at IPMG clinics, and the exploration of a range of scientific, clinical and research projects designed to expand the possibilities of interventional psychiatry and mental health care for the benefit of patients and providers.


“We are proud to establish this partnership with IPMG as we explore ways to mutually advance our shared goal of improving patients’ lives through a variety of interventional psychiatry treatments,” said Hadar Levy, Chief Executive Officer of BrainsWay. “This cooperation serves to advance the interests of the patients we serve, and further reflects our strategy of building relationships with key accelerators of innovation in the mental health space.”


BrainsWay Deep TMS is an innovative therapy delivered through a patented and unique coil design which is housed within a cushioned, patient and provider-friendly helmet. By pulsing a magnetic field that targets affected structures of the brain, the Deep TMS system is capable of stimulating underactive neural networks. The system is currently FDA-cleared to treat major depressive disorder both with and without anxiety symptoms, obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), and smoking addiction.


**About BrainsWay**


BrainsWay is a global leader in advanced noninvasive neurostimulation treatments for mental health disorders. The Company is advancing neuroscience with its proprietary Deep Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (Deep TMS™) platform technology to improve health and transform lives. BrainsWay is the first and only TMS company to obtain three FDA-cleared indications backed by pivotal clinical studies demonstrating clinically proven efficacy. Current indications include major depressive disorder (including reduction of anxiety symptoms, commonly referred to as anxious depression), obsessive-compulsive disorder, and smoking addiction. The Company is dedicated to leading through superior science and building on its unparalleled body of clinical evidence. Additional clinical trials of Deep TMS in various psychiatric, neurological, and addiction disorders are underway. Founded in 2003, with operations in the United States and Israel, BrainsWay is committed to increasing global awareness of and broad access to Deep TMS. For the latest news and information about BrainsWay, please visit[www.brainsway.com](http://www.brainsway.com/) .
